name: Portable Runway Flare Pot
blurb: A Hangar-only portable flare pot with separate lit and unlit review markers and no smoke or light effect.
history: Portable flame lights could mark temporary landing strips during restricted lighting conditions. This small campaign object is an estimated silhouette informed by wartime blackout and aviation-lighting practice.

sources.title: Wartime blackout and aviation-lighting guidance, U.S. Government Printing Office
